==Behind the scenes==
Camele was mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine, published in [[November]] [[1995]]. The feature was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Sterling Hershey]].<ref name="Journal8" />
